svg.title: PostgreSQL data model
svg.desc: Data model. The chunks, document_fingerprints, ingest_jobs and document_pdf_extractions tables reference documents.id with cascading deletion. The documents table holds an incarnation UUID. The document_deletions table stores receipts keyed by public document UUID independently of the live row, and document_deletion_activation stores the singleton activation timestamp. The source_uploads table journals original-file uploads and references documents.id with cascading deletion once acceptance links an upload. The vector_generations table records each vector target and its embedding profile, vector_generation_documents holds the per-document write ledger of a generation and references vector_generations.name, and vector_state records the active generation and the writer freeze. PK denotes primary key and FK denotes foreign key. SQL types appear beside every column. The evaluation_fixtures table keeps receipt-qualified UUID reservations. Its active document reference restricts deletion until cleanup completes.
